subject: pangolier_shield_crash
definition: 吸收一定伤害、按比例减少受到的伤害，或把受到的伤害延迟结算（如统帅朗姆酒、虚妄之诺）
evidence: 甲盾冲击只要击中任意敌方英雄，他就能在短时间内获得一定数值的全伤害护盾。
Pangolier gains an all damage barrier for a short time if Shield Crash hits an enemy hero.

context.description_en:
Pangolier jumps in the air and slams back to the ground in front of his current position damaging all enemies in a radius. Pangolier gains an all damage barrier for a short time if Shield Crash hits an enemy hero.

Forward movement is maintained if Shield Crash is used while Rolling Thunder is active, and allows Rolling Thunder to clear walls or cliffs.
context.description_zh:
石鳞剑士跃入空中，再落向当前位置的前方地面造成冲击，对范围内所有敌人造成伤害。甲盾冲击只要击中任意敌方英雄，他就能在短时间内获得一定数值的全伤害护盾。

地雷滚滚过程中使用甲盾冲击将会保持前进，并且可以使地雷滚滚跨过地形障碍。

scepter_loc.en: Causes Shield Crash to cast a 2-attack Swashbuckle every 90 degrees around your hero that deals %scepter_damage_outgoing_tooltip%%% damage.
scepter_loc.zh: 甲盾冲击将围绕英雄每90度施放一个刺击2次的虚张声势，造成%scepter_damage_outgoing_tooltip%%%伤害。

subject: pavise
definition: 吸收一定伤害、按比例减少受到的伤害，或把受到的伤害延迟结算（如统帅朗姆酒、虚妄之诺）
evidence: When cast on an ally, grants them a physical damage barrier that absorbs 250 damage.

abilities.title: Protect
abilities.description: When cast on an ally, grants them a physical damage barrier that absorbs 250 damage. Duration: 7s.

subject: shadow_shaman_fowl_play
definition: 吸收一定伤害、按比例减少受到的伤害，或把受到的伤害延迟结算（如统帅朗姆酒、虚妄之诺）
evidence: 受到的伤害减免效果会阻止生命移除类效果杀死暗影萨满。

context.description_en:
When taking lethal damage, Shadow Shaman receives a strong dispel and survives as a 1 HP chicken with increased movement speed. Incoming damage is reduced to zero for a short duration and additional chickens are created to confuse the enemy. Cooldown resets when Shadow Shaman respawns.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
context.description_zh:
受到致死伤害时，暗影萨满会获得强驱散效果，并且以1点生命的小鸡继续存活。受到的伤害将降为零，持续较短时间，并且额外产生若干只小鸡，迷惑敌人。冷却时间会在暗影萨满复活时重置。

驱散类型：强驱散
notes_en: Lethal Damage from Axe's Culling Blade and Necrophos's Reaper's Scythe will not be prevented.
Incoming damage reduction buff will prevent certain sources of HP removal from killing Shadow Shaman.
notes_zh: 无法阻止斧王的淘汰之刃和瘟疫法师的死神镰刀的致死伤害。
受到的伤害减免效果会阻止生命移除类效果杀死暗影萨满。

subject: skywrath_mage_shield_of_the_scion
definition: 吸收一定伤害、按比例减少受到的伤害，或把受到的伤害延迟结算（如统帅朗姆酒、虚妄之诺）
evidence: 每次天怒法师用技能对敌方英雄造成魔法伤害时，他都会获得小型的魔法伤害护盾。
Every time Skywrath Mage deals magical damage to an enemy hero with his abilities, he gains a small magic damage barrier.

context.description_en: Every time Skywrath Mage deals magical damage to an enemy hero with his abilities, he gains a small magic damage barrier. Each buff stacks independently.
context.description_zh: 每次天怒法师用技能对敌方英雄造成魔法伤害时，他都会获得小型的魔法伤害护盾。每个加成状态独立叠加。

subject: spectre_dispersion
definition: 吸收一定伤害、按比例减少受到的伤害，或把受到的伤害延迟结算（如统帅朗姆酒、虚妄之诺）
evidence: 折射可以主动施放，吸收和反弹的伤害比例提升%activation_bonus_pct%%%，持续%activation_duration%秒。

context.description_en: Spectre disperses part of the damage dealt to her, reflecting it to all nearby enemies. The effect lessens with distance.
context.description_zh: 幽灵会分散对她造成的部分伤害，将其反弹给附近的所有敌人。敌人离她越远，受到的伤害越低。
notes_en: The reflected damage is not dealt to Spectre.
Illusions don't get this ability.
Damage is reflected before reductions, and is returned as the same damage type.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
notes_zh: 幽鬼本身不承受被折射的伤害。
幻象并不继承此技能。
伤害在减免前折射，并且折射的伤害与原伤害类型相同。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

shard_loc.en: Dispersion can be activated to increase the amount absorbed and reflected by Dispersion by %activation_bonus_pct%%% of its base values for %activation_duration%s. Cooldown %activation_cooldown%. Manacost %activation_manacost%.
shard_loc.zh: 折射可以主动施放，吸收和反弹的伤害比例提升%activation_bonus_pct%%%，持续%activation_duration%秒。冷却时间为%activation_cooldown%秒。魔法消耗为%activation_manacost%点。

subject: templar_assassin_refraction
definition: 吸收一定伤害、按比例减少受到的伤害，或把受到的伤害延迟结算（如统帅朗姆酒、虚妄之诺）
evidence: 攻击力加成和护盾效果相互独立，并且都是有限次数的效果。
If an instance of damage would deal more damage than the remaining barrier, all of the damage is absorbed.
如果单次伤害超过了剩余的护盾，该次的全部伤害都会被吸收。
If a barrier is consumed, a new one is created as long as there are charges left.
Templar Assassin becomes highly elusive, gaining a small barrier and bonus to her damage.
如果护盾被摧毁，只要还有能量点数就会再产生一个新的。
圣堂刺客变得高度难以捉摸，获得一个小型护盾，同时获得攻击力加成。

context.description_en: Templar Assassin becomes highly elusive, gaining a small barrier and bonus to her damage.  The damage and avoidance effects are separate, and have a limited number of instances. If a barrier is consumed, a new one is created as long as there are charges left. If an instance of damage would deal more damage than the remaining barrier, all of the damage is absorbed.
context.description_zh: 圣堂刺客变得高度难以捉摸，获得一个小型护盾，同时获得攻击力加成。攻击力加成和护盾效果相互独立，并且都是有限次数的效果。如果护盾被摧毁，只要还有能量点数就会再产生一个新的。如果单次伤害超过了剩余的护盾，该次的全部伤害都会被吸收。
notes_en: Damage as HP Removal bypasses Refraction (it won't reduce the charges).
notes_zh: 生命移除类伤害将无视折光（也不会减少折光次数）。

shard_loc.en: Increases bonus damage. Refraction can be cast while disabled.
shard_loc.zh: 攻击力加成提升。被控制时可以施放折光。

subject: vanguard
definition: 吸收一定伤害、按比例减少受到的伤害，或把受到的伤害延迟结算（如统帅朗姆酒、虚妄之诺）
evidence: Multiple sources of damage block do not stack.

abilities.title: Damage Block
abilities.description: Grants a 60% chance to block 50 damage from incoming attacks on melee heroes, and 25 damage on ranged.

context.notes: Multiple sources of damage block do not stack.

subject: vengefulspirit_nether_swap
definition: 吸收一定伤害、按比例减少受到的伤害，或把受到的伤害延迟结算（如统帅朗姆酒、虚妄之诺）
evidence: 复仇之魂和被交换的友方英雄都会获得等同于造成伤害的护盾。
Vengeful Spirit and allied swapped units gain a barrier equal to the damage dealt.

context.description_en: Instantaneously swaps positions with a target Hero, friend or enemy. Nether Swap interrupts channeling abilities on the target. Enemy Swapped units take damage. Vengeful Spirit and allied swapped units gain a barrier equal to the damage dealt.
context.description_zh: 与一个目标英雄瞬间交换位置，不论敌我。移形换位会打断目标的持续施法。敌方英雄被交换后受到伤害。复仇之魂和被交换的友方英雄都会获得等同于造成伤害的护盾。
notes_en: Works on Spell Immune units.
Trees near Vengeful Spirit and the target will be destroyed when the spell is cast.
Channeling spells are interrupted by Nether Swap.
notes_zh: 对减益免疫单位有效。
技能施放后复仇之魂和目标附近的树木将会被摧毁。
移形换位能够打断持续施法。

subject: void_spirit_resonant_pulse
definition: 吸收一定伤害、按比例减少受到的伤害，或把受到的伤害延迟结算（如统帅朗姆酒、虚妄之诺）
evidence: 脉冲每击中一名敌方英雄，护盾的伤害吸收量都会提升。
虚无之灵将自己包裹在保护性护盾之中，可以吸收物理伤害，并围绕自身发出一次伤害性脉冲。

context.description_en: Void Spirit wraps himself in a protective shield that absorbs physical damage and emits a single damaging pulse around him. The shield gains increased damage absorption for each enemy hero the pulse hits.
context.description_zh: 虚无之灵将自己包裹在保护性护盾之中，可以吸收物理伤害，并围绕自身发出一次伤害性脉冲。脉冲每击中一名敌方英雄，护盾的伤害吸收量都会提升。

scepter_loc.en: Causes Resonant Pulse to silence and gain %max_charges% charges.
scepter_loc.zh: 共鸣脉冲可以沉默敌人，并获得%max_charges%点能量点数。

evidence: Everytime you are attacked, you return 10 damage plus 15% of the attack damage dealt to you.

context.notes:
Damage Return is calculated before any kind of reduction.
Returned damage type is the same as it was received.
Damage done by this item is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

evidence: 5 seconds, return all incoming damage, increasing the percentage by 85%.

abilities.description: For 5.5 seconds, return all incoming damage, increasing the percentage by 85%.

subject: nyx_assassin_spiked_carapace
definition: 受到攻击或伤害时触发的反击伤害：按比例返还所受伤害、固定值反击，或受伤触发的范围伤害（如半人马·反伤、斧王·反击螺旋、钢毛后背）；攻击者不一定被打到也算，记条件
definition_note: U33：固定值反击也算；U40、U43：受伤阈值触发的范围伤害（钢毛后背、净化锚击）、勇气之霎（打她正在攻击的目标）附条件算；反弹法术不算（U51前复核一致，助手整理）
evidence: 反弹的伤害与司夜刺客受到的伤害类型相同。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。
When activated while above ground, Spiked Carapace reflects and negates damage dealt to Nyx Assassin (max once from each source), as well as stunning the source of the damage.
The damage reflected will have the same damage type as it had when it was dealt to Nyx Assassin.
反弹的伤害与司夜刺客本应受到的实际伤害相同。
激活状态下，尖刺外壳可以反弹并无效化司夜刺客受到的伤害（每个攻击者最多作用一次），同时眩晕攻击者。

context.description_en:
When activated while above ground, Spiked Carapace reflects and negates damage dealt to Nyx Assassin (max once from each source), as well as stunning the source of the damage. Activating Spiked Carapace will not break Vendetta invisibility.

While Burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast.
context.description_zh:
激活状态下，尖刺外壳可以反弹并无效化司夜刺客受到的伤害（每个攻击者最多作用一次），同时眩晕攻击者。激活尖刺外壳不会打破复仇的隐身状态。

钻地状态下尖刺外壳施放后将立刻眩晕周围的敌人。
notes_en: The damage is calculated after all reductions.
Spiked Carapace will only trigger on damage from other player controlled sources.
The damage reflected will have the same damage type as it had when it was dealt to Nyx Assassin.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
notes_zh: 反弹的伤害与司夜刺客本应受到的实际伤害相同。
尖刺外壳只有在受到玩家控制来源的伤害后会反弹。
反弹的伤害与司夜刺客受到的伤害类型相同。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

subject: dazzle_shallow_grave
definition: 在一段时间内生命值不会降到0以下（如薄葬、回光返照）
evidence: An ally blessed with Shallow Grave, no matter how close to death, cannot die while under its protection.

context.description_en: An ally blessed with Shallow Grave, no matter how close to death, cannot die while under its protection. Healing on that ally is also amplified for the duration based on the hero's HP.
context.description_zh: 友军身受薄葬的福佑，在其保护下不论受到多大的伤害都不会阵亡。对该友军的治疗效果在持续时间内也会根据其生命值得到增强。
notes_en: HP cannot go below 1 while under the effects of Shallow Grave, but Axe's Culling Blade will still kill the hero.
notes_zh: 在薄葬作用下生命值至少为1点，但是斧王的淘汰之刃还是可以斩杀目标英雄。

subject: chen_hand_of_god
definition: 处于减益免疫（技能免疫）时，只有能穿透减益免疫的效果才对其生效（如碎颅锤的重击可以眩晕开了黑皇杖的单位）
evidence: 初始治疗会在持续施法起始时发生，持续施法期间其他附近友方单位变为减益免疫状态，拥有%debuff_immune_resist%%%魔法抗性，而且持续治疗的威力提升%nearby_hot_boost%%%。

The initial heal happens at the start of the channel, and while channeling other nearby allied units become debuff immune with %debuff_immune_resist%%% magic resistance and the power of the heal over time is increased by %nearby_hot_boost%%%.

context.description_en: Heals all allied heroes on the map as well as all units under Chen's control. A large heal is applied at first and a slow heal over time is applied for %hot_duration% seconds afterwards.
context.description_zh: 治疗地图上的所有友军英雄以及陈控制的所有单位。一开始先施加高额治疗，在之后%hot_duration%秒内持续进行小额治疗。
notes_en: Can heal invulnerable and hidden/banished allies.
notes_zh: 可以治疗无敌和被隐藏/放逐友军。

scepter_loc.en: Decreases the cooldown of Hand of God to %AbilityCooldown%s and it becomes a channelled spell that lasts for up to %AbilityChannelTime% seconds. The initial heal happens at the start of the channel, and while channeling other nearby allied units become debuff immune with %debuff_immune_resist%%% magic resistance and the power of the heal over time is increased by %nearby_hot_boost%%%.
scepter_loc.zh: 上帝之手的冷却时间降低至%AbilityCooldown%秒，并且变为持续施法型技能，持续最多%AbilityChannelTime%秒。初始治疗会在持续施法起始时发生，持续施法期间其他附近友方单位变为减益免疫状态，拥有%debuff_immune_resist%%%魔法抗性，而且持续治疗的威力提升%nearby_hot_boost%%%。

subject: elder_titan_ancestral_spirit
definition: 处于减益免疫（技能免疫）时，只有能穿透减益免疫的效果才对其生效（如碎颅锤的重击可以眩晕开了黑皇杖的单位）
evidence: Causes Elder Titan to become debuff immune and gain %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance for %scepter_magic_immune_per_hero% seconds per affected enemy Hero when the spirit returns.
游魂每碰到一名英雄就能使上古巨神在游魂回归后获得%scepter_magic_immune_per_hero%秒减益免疫状态和%immunity_resist%%%魔法抗性提升。

context.description_en:
Elder Titan sends forth his Astral Spirit, damaging any units it passes through.  When the spirit rejoins the Titan, it grants bonus damage and movement speed for each unit it passed through.

The Astral Spirit possesses the Echo Stomp, Return Spirit, and Natural Order abilities.
context.description_zh:
上古巨神放出他的灵体游魂，灵魂对任何经过的单位都会造成伤害。当它与巨神合体时，它每伤害过一个单位都会给予若干攻击力和移动速度加成。

灵体游魂拥有回音重踏，回归和自然秩序三个技能。

scepter_loc.en: Causes Elder Titan to become debuff immune and gain %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance for %scepter_magic_immune_per_hero% seconds per affected enemy Hero when the spirit returns.
scepter_loc.zh: 游魂每碰到一名英雄就能使上古巨神在游魂回归后获得%scepter_magic_immune_per_hero%秒减益免疫状态和%immunity_resist%%%魔法抗性提升。

subject: grimstroke_dark_portrait
definition: 处于减益免疫（技能免疫）时，只有能穿透减益免疫的效果才对其生效（如碎颅锤的重击可以眩晕开了黑皇杖的单位）
evidence: Illusion is debuff immune, has %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance, and has bonus movement speed and attack damage.
幻象为减益免疫状态，拥有%immunity_resist%%%魔法抗性，移动速度和继承攻击力超过本体。

context.description_en: Creates an ink illusion of a target enemy hero. Illusion is debuff immune, has %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance, and has bonus movement speed and attack damage.
context.description_zh: 制造目标敌方英雄的墨色幻象。幻象为减益免疫状态，拥有%immunity_resist%%%魔法抗性，移动速度和继承攻击力超过本体。

subject: huskar_life_break
definition: 处于减益免疫（技能免疫）时，只有能穿透减益免疫的效果才对其生效（如碎颅锤的重击可以眩晕开了黑皇杖的单位）
evidence: 减速效果无视减益免疫。
哈斯卡在跳跃过程中为减益免疫，并且魔法抗性提升%immunity_resist%%%。
While leaping, Huskar is Debuff Immune with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance.

context.description_en:
Huskar draws upon his health to break an enemy's life, leaping at a target to shatter a percentage of that hero's current health and slow both their movement and attack speed.  While leaping, Huskar is Debuff Immune with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
哈斯卡牺牲自己的生命来摧毁敌人的生命，他跃向一个目标，造成目标当前生命值一定百分比的伤害，并且降低目标的移动和攻击速度。哈斯卡在跳跃过程中为减益免疫，并且魔法抗性提升%immunity_resist%%%。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes_en: If Huskar is disabled during the charge or the target moves more than 1400 units in 0.015 seconds, the charge stops.
Slow works on Spell Immune units.
Life Break cannot be disjointed.
notes_zh: 如果哈斯卡在跳跃时受到控制技能，或目标在0.015秒内移动1400码以上，跳跃就会停止。
减速效果无视减益免疫。
牺牲无法被躲避。

scepter_loc.en: Forces the enemy target to attack Huskar and increases cast range.
scepter_loc.zh: 强迫敌方目标攻击哈斯卡，并提升施法距离。

subject: lion_mana_drain
definition: 处于减益免疫（技能免疫）时，只有能穿透减益免疫的效果才对其生效（如碎颅锤的重击可以眩晕开了黑皇杖的单位）
evidence: Lion becomes Debuff Immune with %magic_resist%%% magic resistance while channeling.
持续施法期间莱恩为减益免疫状态，并且获得%magic_resist%%%魔法抗性。

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Channels magical energy, taking mana and slowing enemies over time. If the enemy has no mana remaining, the slow is increased by %movespeed_bonus_when_empty_pct%%%.  Can target allies to give them mana and movement speed at a %ally_pct%%% rate.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 引导魔法能量，持续吸取魔法并减缓敌人的移动速度。如果敌人没有魔法剩余，减速效果提升%movespeed_bonus_when_empty_pct%%%。可以对友军施放，给予他们%ally_pct%%%魔法和移动速度。
notes_en: Prevents heroes from going invisible.
notes_zh: 阻止英雄进入隐身状态。

shard_loc.en: Causes Mana Drain to affect up to %shard_bonus_targets% additional enemies and increases break distance. Lion becomes Debuff Immune with %magic_resist%%% magic resistance while channeling.
shard_loc.zh: 法力吸取可以作用最多%shard_bonus_targets%个额外敌人，并且断裂距离增加。持续施法期间莱恩为减益免疫状态，并且获得%magic_resist%%%魔法抗性。

subject: pangolier_gyroshell
definition: 处于减益免疫（技能免疫）时，只有能穿透减益免疫的效果才对其生效（如碎颅锤的重击可以眩晕开了黑皇杖的单位）
evidence: Pangolier curls into a debuff immune ball with %magic_resistance%%% magic resistance and rolls out.
石鳞剑士卷成一个减益免疫状态的圆球，拥有%magic_resistance%%%魔法抗性，隆隆地向前滚去。

context.description_en:
Pangolier curls into a debuff immune ball with %magic_resistance%%% magic resistance and rolls out. When rolling, he moves at an increased speed and can move through trees, but has a decreased ability to turn. Striking enemies knocks them back, inflicting damage proportional to his attack damage and stunning them when they land. 

Colliding with walls or cliffs will cause a temporary pause while Pangolier reverses in direction.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
石鳞剑士卷成一个减益免疫状态的圆球，拥有%magic_resistance%%%魔法抗性，隆隆地向前滚去。滚动时移动速度提升，可以碾过树木，但是转身速率降低。敌人被击中后会被击退，然后受到与他的攻击力成正比的伤害，并且被眩晕。

与地形障碍相撞后会暂时停止滚动，并且滚动方向变反。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes_en: Enemies can be stunned multiple times per use, but cannot be affected a subsequent time until the previous stun duration ends.
If Pangolier is disabled while rolling, he will continue to stun and knock enemies that come within range.
It takes Pangolier %move_speed_ramp_up_time%s to reach full roll speed.
notes_zh: 敌人在技能期间可以多次被眩晕，但是只有上一次眩晕结束后才会再次被眩晕。
即使石鳞剑士在滚动时被控制，他依然会对范围内敌人造成眩晕和击退。
石鳞剑士需要%move_speed_ramp_up_time%秒才能达到全额的滚动速度。

subject: pangolier_rollup
definition: 处于减益免疫（技能免疫）时，只有能穿透减益免疫的效果才对其生效（如碎颅锤的重击可以眩晕开了黑皇杖的单位）
evidence: 石鳞剑士将自身卷成保护性的圆球，获得减益免疫状态，拥有%magic_resistance%%%魔法抗性加成，并且可以转身。
Pangolier curls into an immobile protective ball, gaining debuff immunity, %magic_resistance%%% magic resistance, and allowing him to turn.

context.description_en: Pangolier curls into an immobile protective ball, gaining debuff immunity, %magic_resistance%%% magic resistance, and allowing him to turn. Can be cast during Rolling Thunder to temporarily hit the brakes. Can cast Rolling Thunder and Shield Crash during Roll Up. If enemies attack Pangolier during this, he will roll away from the attacker, applying Rolling Thunder damage/stun if there are enemies in the way.
context.description_zh: 石鳞剑士将自身卷成保护性的圆球，获得减益免疫状态，拥有%magic_resistance%%%魔法抗性加成，并且可以转身。可以在地雷滚滚期间施放，暂停滚动。可以在卷土重来期间施放地雷滚滚和甲盾冲击。若敌人在此期间发动攻击，将滚离攻击者，对途中的敌人施加地雷滚滚的伤害/眩晕。

subject: templar_assassin_psionic_trap
definition: 处于减益免疫（技能免疫）时，只有能穿透减益免疫的效果才对其生效（如碎颅锤的重击可以眩晕开了黑皇杖的单位）
evidence: They have invisibility that fades in over %trap_fade_time% seconds and spell immunity.
他们拥有隐形效果，渐隐时间为%trap_fade_time%秒，还拥有技能免疫状态。

context.description_en: Templar Assassin places mystical traps that invisibly monitor enemy movement. When sprung at her command, they exert a slowing influence of %movement_speed_min%%% in a %trap_radius% radius. Trap movement slow charges up to %movement_speed_max%%% after %trap_max_charge_duration% seconds. Deals damage after %trap_max_charge_duration%s.
context.description_zh: 圣堂刺客放下一个隐形的神秘陷阱监视敌人的动向。引爆后将减缓%trap_radius%范围内敌人的移动速度，陷阱放置时间越久，引爆后减速效果越强，最低为%movement_speed_min%%%，放置%trap_max_charge_duration%秒后引爆将达到最大减速效果，为%movement_speed_max%%%，并且还能造成额外伤害。
notes_en: Traps last indefinitely.
They have invisibility that fades in over %trap_fade_time% seconds and spell immunity. They take 2 hits to kill by ranged heroes, 1 by melee heroes, and 4 by creeps.
Traps have 250/250 vision range and don't prevent neutral camps from spawning.
notes_zh: 陷阱没有时间限制。
他们拥有隐形效果，渐隐时间为%trap_fade_time%秒，还拥有技能免疫状态。他们可以承受2次远程英雄的攻击，1次近战英雄的攻击，或4次非英雄单位的攻击。
陷阱的视野是250/250，不能阻止中立生物刷新。

scepter_loc.en: When activated, traps now silence affected enemies.
scepter_loc.zh: 现在陷阱引爆后还会沉默受到作用的敌人。

subject: terrorblade_sunder
definition: 处于减益免疫（技能免疫）时，只有能穿透减益免疫的效果才对其生效（如碎颅锤的重击可以眩晕开了黑皇杖的单位）
evidence: Debuff Immune enemies don't get their HP modified.

context.description_en: Severs the life from both Terrorblade and a target hero, exchanging a percentage of both units' current health. Some health points must remain.
context.description_zh: 隔断恐怖利刃以及目标英雄的灵魂并将双方的当前血量百分比进行互换。交换后双方英雄的生命值必定在一定百分比以上。
notes_en: Debuff Immune enemies don't get their HP modified.
notes_zh: 减益免疫的敌人不会被影响生命值。

subject: oracle_fates_edict
definition: 目标无法普通攻击
evidence: 神谕者让目标沉醉，将其缴械并提升其%magic_damage_resistance_pct_tooltip%%%魔法抗性。

context.description_en: Oracle enraptures a target, disarming them and granting them %magic_damage_resistance_pct_tooltip%%% magic damage resistance.
context.description_zh: 神谕者让目标沉醉，将其缴械并提升其%magic_damage_resistance_pct_tooltip%%%魔法抗性。

subject: sheepstick
definition: 目标无法普通攻击
evidence: The target has a base movement speed of 140 and will be silenced, muted, and disarmed.

abilities.title: Hex
abilities.description:
Turns a target unit into a harmless critter for 2.8 seconds. The target has a base movement speed of 140 and will be silenced, muted, and disarmed.
Instantly destroys illusions.

context.notes: The target will have a base movement speed of 140, but buffs granting maximum movement speed won't be disabled.

subject: sniper_concussive_grenade
definition: 目标无法普通攻击
evidence: 受到作用的敌人被击退后还会被缴械和减速。
Enemies affected are disarmed and have their movement slowed after the knockback.

context.description_en: Launches a grenade at the target area, dealing damage to enemies and knocking them and Sniper back. Enemies affected are disarmed and have their movement slowed after the knockback.
context.description_zh: 向目标区域扔出一枚手雷，对敌人造成伤害并将他们和狙击手一同击退。受到作用的敌人被击退后还会被缴械和减速。

shard_loc.en: Reduces cooldown, increases damage, and allows the knockback to affect Sniper as well.
shard_loc.zh: 降低冷却时间，提升伤害并允许技能也能击退狙击手。

subject: batrider_flamebreak
definition: 拉、推、交换、投掷其他单位（如动人之舐、移形换位）
evidence: 投掷一瓶爆炸性的混合物，到达目标地点时爆炸，击退区域内的敌人并造成减速和持续伤害。

context.description_en: Hurls an explosive cocktail that explodes when it reaches the target location, knocking back, slowing and dealing damage over time to enemies in the area.
context.description_zh: 投掷一瓶爆炸性的混合物，到达目标地点时爆炸，击退区域内的敌人并造成减速和持续伤害。

subject: disruptor_electromagnetic_repulsion
definition: 拉、推、交换、投掷其他单位（如动人之舐、移形换位）
evidence: Whenever Disruptor takes more than %damage_threshold% damage from any source within %effect_radius% radius, all nearby enemies within take damage equal to %damage_per_int%x of Disruptor's Intelligence, and are pushed back up to a %effect_radius% distance away.
每当干扰者受到%effect_radius%范围内来自任意来源的%damage_threshold%点伤害，附近所有敌人都会受到%damage_per_int%倍干扰者智力值的伤害，并且被推开最多%effect_radius%距离。

context.description_en: Whenever Disruptor takes more than %damage_threshold% damage from any source within %effect_radius% radius, all nearby enemies within take damage equal to %damage_per_int%x of Disruptor's Intelligence, and are pushed back up to a %effect_radius% distance away.
context.description_zh: 每当干扰者受到%effect_radius%范围内来自任意来源的%damage_threshold%点伤害，附近所有敌人都会受到%damage_per_int%倍干扰者智力值的伤害，并且被推开最多%effect_radius%距离。
notes_en: After %damage_reset_interval%s, the damage counter is reset.
notes_zh: %damage_reset_interval%秒后伤害计数会重置。

subject: drow_ranger_glacier
definition: 拉、推、交换、投掷其他单位（如动人之舐、移形换位）
evidence: 卓尔游侠在她脚下创造一片冰山，击退附近的敌人。

context.description_en: Drow creates a hill of ice beneath her, knocking away nearby enemies. Units on the hill gain flying vision and Drow and her ranged allies gain bonus attack range. Drow gains additional damage while on the Glacier and attacking targets below her.The front of the hill obscures vision and cannot be moved through except by Drow. Does not interrupt Multishot when cast.
context.description_zh: 卓尔游侠在她脚下创造一片冰山，击退附近的敌人。站在山上的单位会获得飞行视野，而卓尔游侠和她的远程友军会获得攻击距离加成。卓尔游侠站在山上时攻击下方目标时获得额外伤害。山的前面会阻挡视野，并且除了卓尔游侠外无法穿行。施放时不会打断数箭齐发。
